name: ActiveDEMAND
description_en:
ActiveDEMAND currently presents itself as a customer acquisition and engagement platform for senior living, with multi-community marketing, contact relationships and CRM-linked follow-up. Its official agency pages still describe multi-client accounts and separate package levels. Those are distinct buying contexts, not interchangeable prices.

A practical evaluation follows a tour inquiry from a form to the correct community and responsible sales employee, then checks both prospect communication and internal notification. This profile distinguishes current vendor capability claims from a dated but specific troubleshooting article. No campaign, CRM connection or handling of real resident data was performed.
description_zh:
ActiveDEMAND 当前将自身定位为养老社区获客及互动平台，包含多社区营销、联系人关系及 CRM 跟进。其官方代理商页仍介绍多客户账户和独立套餐；两者是不同购买情境，价格不能互换。

评估可沿参观咨询从表单到正确社区及负责销售人员，检查对外沟通及内部通知。本文区分当前厂商能力宣传与一篇较旧但具体的排障文章。未运行活动、连接 CRM 或处理真实住户数据。

sections.title_en: Choose the current community or agency context first
sections.title_zh: 先选择当前社区或代理商范围
sections.en:
The homepage now emphasizes senior living operators and multi-community acquisition. The agency pricing and package pages separately describe portal management and client accounts. Preserve that distinction when evaluating the existing catalog identity: the same vendor offers more than one commercial context.

For a senior living operator, begin with community-level scheduling, relationships and the specific CRM reseller. For an agency, examine client package permissions and portal scope. Neither context proves that all features, AI assistance or contact allowances on the other page are included. This profile does not infer an acquisition date or reason for the positioning change.
sections.zh:
首页当前强调养老运营者及多社区获客；代理商价格及套餐页则单独介绍门户与客户账户。评估现有目录对象时需保留区别，同一厂商存在多个商业情境。

养老运营者应从社区排程、关系及具体 CRM 经销方开始；代理商应核对客户套餐权限及门户范围。两者都不能证明另一页的全部功能、AI 或联系人额度已包含。本文不推断定位变化时间或原因。

sections.title_en: Trace one inquiry to one responsible team
sections.title_zh: 将一次咨询追踪到明确负责团队
sections.en:
The platform page describes forms, chat, drip sequences, call tracking and appointment scheduling. It also describes contact relationships for families participating in a decision. In an illustrative tour inquiry, record the chosen community and the person requesting follow-up, then route the action to the responsible team.

That is an evaluation design, not a tested recipe. A shared family relationship should not be treated as a shared email identity or universal permission to message everyone. Test a second relative, a changed community preference and a cancellation separately. Verify which contact receives a reminder and which employee receives an internal notification.
sections.zh:
平台页介绍表单、聊天、滴灌、电话跟踪及预约排程，也描述参与决策的家庭联系人关系。参观咨询示例中，可记录所选社区及请求跟进的人，再把动作交给负责团队。

这是评估设计，非实测配方。同一家庭关系不等于共享邮箱身份，也不代表可向所有人发消息。应分别测试第二位亲属、社区偏好变更及取消，核对谁收到提醒、哪位员工收到内部通知。

sections.title_en: A CRM brand can contain different products
sections.title_zh: 同一 CRM 品牌可能包含不同产品
sections.en:
The integration directory distinguishes Aline CRM formerly Enquire from Aline’s Prospect-Centered Selling formerly Sherpa, and names WelcomeHome, Yardi and other senior-living connectors. It also lists separate B2B, website and calendar integrations.

For the tour scenario, verify the exact product/version, account permissions, relationship identifiers and fields that can move in each direction. Ask how an existing record is matched and how community changes affect ownership. The directory does not establish a universal sync interval, conflict rule or exactly-once delivery guarantee. Successful form capture is not proof that the downstream CRM or calendar was updated.
sections.zh:
集成目录区分原 Enquire 的 Aline CRM 与原 Sherpa 的 Aline Prospect-Centered Selling，并列 WelcomeHome、Yardi 等养老连接器；另有 B2B、网站及日历集成。

参观示例需确认准确产品／版本、账户权限、关系标识及各方向可传字段。应核对现有记录如何匹配、社区变化如何影响归属。目录未规定统一同步间隔、冲突规则或恰好一次保证。表单采集成功，不能证明下游 CRM 或日历已更新。

sections.title_en: A captured lead can still fail to notify sales
sections.title_zh: 线索采集成功也可能无法通知销售
sections.en:
The published troubleshooting article distinguishes an Unsubscribed Error for an employee from Sales Notification was not sent. The latter can mean the distribution list is empty or every listed employee is unsubscribed. It directs investigation to the account, workflow, triggering contact/activity and employee timeline; DNS or receiving-system errors can also appear there.

The article dates to 2021, so validate its current UI and behavior. Diagnose the delivery cause and current permission before any reactivation; do not blindly apply its email-address deletion workaround to prospects. Test one notification failure and verify that a successful form submission is still visible to the team responsible for follow-up.
sections.zh:
公开排障文章区分员工的 Unsubscribed Error 与 Sales Notification was not sent；后者可能因分发列表为空或员工全部退订。它建议检查账户、流程、触发联系人／活动及员工时间线，DNS 或收件系统错误也可能在其中。

文章发表于 2021 年，需验证当前界面及行为。重新启用前应诊断投递原因及现有许可，不能将其删除邮箱的变通方式直接用于潜在客户。需测试一次通知失败，并确认负责团队仍能看到成功表单。

sections.title_en: Price by community and verify the reseller terms
sections.title_zh: 按社区计价并核对经销条款
sections.en:
The current senior-living page displays Community Engage at $250 per community/month and Community Marketer at $300. Marketer lists unlimited users, 1,500-contact capacity per community, email sequences, targeted forms and workflows on top of Engage. The page says operators usually purchase via their senior-living CRM and prices may vary by reseller.

For a hypothetical three-community Marketer deployment, the displayed base arithmetic is $900/month before reseller adjustments, usage charges, tax or other contracted work. That is not a quote. Ask how shared family contacts, cross-community records, calls, SMS and implementation affect the actual total.
sections.zh:
当前养老价格页显示 Community Engage 每社区每月 $250，Community Marketer $300。Marketer 列出不限用户、每社区 1,500 联系人，以及 Engage 之上的邮件系列、目标表单及流程。页面称运营者通常通过养老 CRM 购买，价格可能因经销方不同。

假设三个社区均用 Marketer，显示基础算术为每月 $900，未计经销调整、使用费、税或合同其他工作。这不是报价。应确认跨社区家庭联系人、通话、短信及实施如何影响真实总额。

sections.title_en: An agency portal is not the same purchase as a community
sections.title_zh: 代理商门户与社区购买不同
sections.en:
Agency pricing describes Starter as paying for selected client accounts and Expert as pooled contact capacity after a threshold, with a different portal level. Its agency package matrix distinguishes Reporter from Small Business Marketer and Corporate Marketer: Reporter is not presented as an email-sequence package, and custom lead workflows/scoring are placed in Corporate.

A portal entry price should not be quoted as a complete marketing installation for every client. Confirm portal cost, client package, pooled capacity, thresholds and contract term together. The available page excerpts did not establish every current per-client price or threshold rule, so no normalized agency total is supplied.
sections.zh:
代理商价格将 Starter 描述为按所选客户账户支付，Expert 达门槛后按汇总联系人容量计价，并提供不同门户级别。套餐表区分 Reporter、Small Business Marketer 及 Corporate Marketer：Reporter 不作为邮件系列套餐，定制线索流程／评分在 Corporate。

不能把门户起价当作每位客户完整营销安装费用。需同时确认门户、客户套餐、汇总容量、门槛及合同期限。可用页面片段未确立全部当前客户价或门槛规则，因此不提供标准化代理商总额。

sections.title_en: Evaluate capture, handoff and attribution separately
sections.title_zh: 分别验收采集、交接及归因
sections.en:
ActiveDEMAND merits evaluation for multi-location senior-living communications or an agency managing distinct client contexts. The platform describes campaign cloning, rollup dashboards and collective-journey attribution. Those capabilities should be checked against real community assignments and a known inquiry history, without accepting vendor occupancy or AI-security claims as independent evidence.

A small evaluation should verify a successful inquiry, a duplicate/related contact, an opted-out recipient and a failed internal notification. Detailed drip reentry, pause/resume, deletion recovery and retry semantics were not established from accessible articles. No account, connector, campaign or outcome was tested; deployment rights and contractual data handling remain separate checks.
sections.zh:
多地点养老沟通或管理独立客户情境的代理商，可评估 ActiveDEMAND。平台介绍活动复制、汇总仪表盘及集体路径归因；应按真实社区归属及已知咨询历史核对，不能将入住提升或 AI 安全宣传当作独立证据。

小规模评估应验证成功咨询、重复／关联联系人、退出收件人及内部通知失败。可访问文章未确立滴灌重入、暂停恢复、删除恢复及重试细节。未测试账户、连接器、活动或结果，部署权利与合同数据处理仍需另查。

seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Several detailed drip and sales-list articles returned no readable body. Current pause/reentry/retry, exact field mapping and duplicate handling need account-specific documentation or demonstration. The readable notification procedure is dated 2021.
research_gaps.zh: 多篇滴灌及销售列表文章未返回可读正文。当前暂停／重入／重试、精确字段及重复处理需账户文档或演示；可读通知流程发表于 2021 年。

research_gaps.en: No account, resident data, send, call, SMS, integration or attribution result was tested. Exact reseller/agency quote, overage, tax, UI languages, regional eligibility, source license, deployment and contractual data location remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、住户数据、发送、通话、短信、集成或归因。准确经销／代理商报价、超额、税、界面语言、地区资格、源码许可、部署及合同数据位置未核实。
